chains.name: Axelar
chains.lede: Delegate in two minutes. Your keys never leave your wallet; rewards land each time we vote on a cross-chain poll.
work: Node operation
Bare metal, two regions, with a hot standby.
Upgrade handling
Every network upgrade since we joined, on schedule.
Monitoring
A missed block wakes someone up, at any hour.
Public record
Our signing and votes are on the explorer for anyone to check.
faq: Is there a minimum?
No. Delegate any amount the chain itself allows.
Do you hold my tokens?
No. They stay in your wallet — delegation is non-custodial.
How often are rewards paid?
Each time we vote on a cross-chain poll — many times an hour — to a balance you claim.
What happens if you go offline?
A standby node takes over. Missed cross-chain polls forfeit their rewards; past half of 94,426 blocks missed, the chain jails it and slashes 0.01%.
Can I unstake at any time?
Yes. Unbonding takes 7 days; rewards stop the moment you ask.

research.since how: MsgCreateValidator for this valoper, tx 6038B8D6FBA441BE26BDA799DCC65042F2649CCF190B02E874AB4BB8180B611E at height 23,517,225 (2026-01-28T05:56:26Z), found by REST tx search. Its slashing signing-info start_height is the same height and its index_offset (11,687,986) equals the blocks since, so it has been in the active set continuously from that block.
research.cadence: Not per block. x/mint inflation is 0 (min/max 0) and transaction fees are burned by Axelar's distribution override, so staking rewards come only from chain-maintainer voting inflation (0.2%/yr per activated chain; /axelar/reward/v1beta1/inflation_rate = 3.4% total). It accrues each block in a per-chain reward pool and is released into x/distribution to each validator that voted correctly when a cross-chain poll completes; a missed or wrong vote clears that validator's pending pool. Measured on our validator: releases in 23 of 120 consecutive 25-block intervals over ~81 minutes (at least ~17 an hour). Block time 1.63 s. Delegators then claim from x/distribution.

other wallets.what: Axelar's own guide to staking AXL (2023-11-21) — names Keplr, the Keplr dashboard, Cosmostation and Ledger

research.notes: Axelar is the one chain here where the Cosmos default ('every block') is untrue: base inflation is 0, fees are burned, and rewards arrive per completed cross-chain poll, not per block (outstanding rewards were flat for most blocks when read block by block). Downtime: signed_blocks_window 94,426 (~43 h at 1.63 s), min_signed 50%, slash 0.01%, jail 2 h minimum; the nexus chain-maintainer thresholds are 100/100, so missed votes cost rewards but do not deregister us. Our earlier Axelar validator axelarvaloper1s0lankh33kprer2l22nank5rvsuh9ksa6utflp ('Redelegate to Encapsulate') is jailed and unbonded; it was not in the Axelar genesis (one gentx), and when it started was not established — so 'since' is for the new address only. Keplr link loaded and opened our validator's modal (Encapsulate, 9%, Stake button).

research.cadence: No x/mint: ixo’s own mint module (/ixo/mint/v1beta1) mints once per daily epoch (identifier “day”, 86,400 s, starting about 05:09 UTC) — 29,000 IXO a day now, 100% to staking, cut by a third every 365 epochs — and x/distribution pays it out in the next block. Measured: our validator’s outstanding rewards were flat, then jumped ~425 IXO at height 19,290,593 (epoch start 19,290,592). Between epochs only transaction fees trickle in per block. Block time 5.57 s.

other wallets.what: ping.pub’s page for our validator, with a Delegate button (Keplr, Leap, Ledger or MetaMask). ixo publishes no wallet list of its own.

research.notes: The default “every epoch” is not wrong here, but the epoch is a day, so the lede and Q3 say so. Keplr’s dashboard does not support ixo (Impact Hub is a community chain in Keplr’s registry; /chains/ixo, /impact-hub, /impacthub all 404), hence REStake (connects Keplr, Leap or Cosmostation; opens our validator’s card). research.notes: Q4 does NOT open with “A standby node takes over.” — for a DVT cluster that sentence misdescribes the mechanism: the validator key is split into seven shares held by seven operators, and SSV’s 3f+1 rule lets a 7-operator cluster keep signing with any 5 up (2 may fail). There is no single node for a standby to replace, and whatever standby we keep behind SSV operator 924 is invisible to the staker. Proposed first sentence instead: “Any five of the cluster’s seven operators keep it signing.” The chain part is Ethereum’s: downtime is never slashed; missed source/target votes are penalised by exactly what they would have paid (no penalty for a missed head vote or proposal); the inactivity leak only applies when the chain goes more than four epochs without finality. Losses are pooled across all stETH holders, so a staker’s exposure to our cluster is diluted to our share of Lido. — Primary button must read “Stake with Lido”, not “Delegate with …”: a staker cannot choose us; Lido’s StakingRouter allocates deposits. The lede and Q1 drop “Delegate” for the same reason. — Withdrawal queue measured today (wq-api.lido.fi, 2026-09-24): ~2 days for a small request, ~3 days for 10,000 ETH, ~5 days for 100,000 ETH; Lido states 1–5 days normally, longer in “bunker mode”. Requests are 100 wei to 1,000 stETH each (larger ones split automatically). — Rate 2.2% matches stETH’s 7-day SMA APR 2.24% (eth-api.lido.fi, reports to 2026-09-23 12:23 UTC). — Operator #43 on-chain: active, 500 vetted/added/deposited, 0 exited. — Kept “Monitoring: A missed block wakes someone up” because Ethereum validators do propose blocks; if you prefer the everyday duty, “A missed attestation wakes someone up, at any hour.” is also true. faq: Is there a minimum?
No. Restake any amount of EIGEN and delegate it to us.
Do you hold my tokens?
No. Your tokens are restaked in EigenLayer’s contracts, and only you can withdraw them.
How often are rewards paid?
Weekly, to a balance you claim in the EigenLayer app — each week becomes claimable about ten days after it ends.
What happens if you go offline?
A standby node takes over. Nothing delegated to us is slashable today; an AVS can eject an operator that misses work, and its rewards stop.
Can I unstake at any time?
Yes. A withdrawal waits 14 days in escrow, earning nothing, then you complete it in the EigenLayer app.
